task_summary: Delivered search input normalization, combobox accessibility contract, and dedicated route document viewer architecture (/archive/document/:projectId) for BukSU CMS-V2: 1) Neutralized native browser search cancel buttons via appearance-none and WebKit pseudo-element overrides, resolving dual clear 'X' button collision with custom state-managed clear button. 2) Implemented WAI-ARIA 1.2 Combobox accessibility contract (role='combobox', aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant), keyboard traversal (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape), pointerdown outside click dismissal, and inputRef focus restoration. 3) Created useArchiveSearchState hook synchronizing q, year_min, year_max, program, sort, scope, and p with history push/replace semantics (typing replaces, filter changes push), preserving facet filters on clear while resetting p=1, and restoring scroll positions via sessionStorage. 4) Eliminated inline split-canvas and modal viewers in favor of dedicated full-viewport page routing at /archive/document/:projectId. 5) Built CanonicalDocumentViewer stripped of drafting/revision diff tools, featuring a consolidated 5-action toolbar (Back to Search, Download PDF, Cite, Originality Badge/Drawer, Copy DOI/Share) with resilient clipboard fallback, missing PDF preview, and missing DOI states. Verified with 24/24 targeted unit tests, 145/145 full client tests, 204/182 endpoint parity (UNMATCHED_COUNT=0), 60/60 agentic checks, and 7-way Playwright visual feedback loop.
